purpose: Teach: 見知らぬ/さんざん/もどる/気まま/だんだんと/何気なく/アナタ/ありとあらゆる

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、見知らぬ人にはお話しないでね
lines.en: Sho, remember — don't talk to people you don't know, okay?
lines.style: Gentle but firm reminder. Protective tone, spoken close and low. The kind of instruction a trusted older sibling gives because she genuinely worries. No condescension.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、運動会でさんざんだったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis… today at sports day was a disaster for me.
lines.style: Soft, matter-of-fact disclosure. A child's quiet admission of embarrassment. Slight pause before naming the awfulness, then acceptance. Looking down slightly.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お家にもどる時は気をつけてね
lines.en: When you're heading home, be careful, okay?
lines.style: Warm check-in, spoken like a ritual. Gentle concern wrapped in simplicity. A small moment of attention before he leaves. Steady, reassuring.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お休みは気ままに遊びたいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, on my days off I want to just play however I feel like.
lines.style: Hopeful, eager. A child's small earnestness about freedom. Direct and simple, without apology. The brightness of wanting something small and true.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、だんだんとお祖母ちゃんと仲よくなってきたわね
lines.en: You know, you and Grandma have been getting closer lately.
lines.style: Observant warmth. Notice something tender has happened without pointing it out too directly. Soft smile in the voice. Conversational, not performance.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、何気なくお父さんの言葉を覚えてるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I notice things Dad says sometimes, without really meaning to.
lines.style: Quiet perceptiveness. A child's sudden depth — the weight of noticing without understanding why it matters. Thoughtful pause. Not precocious, just honestly observant.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、アナタが頑張る姿、メイ姉さん嬉しいわ
lines.en: When I see you trying your best like that, it makes me really happy.
lines.style: Tender and genuine. Mei speaking directly to his effort, not his outcome. Warmth without cloying. The kind of affection that makes a child feel truly seen.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ありとあらゆるおもちゃ集めたいな
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to collect all kinds of toys someday.
lines.style: Wistful, earnest wish. A child's simple ambition spoken with genuine wanting. Soft, not demanding. The dreaminess of imagining future abundance.
